subject: Medford Jazz Festival 2025 Opening Night
overview: The Medford Jazz Festival commenced its 2025 season at the West Medford Community Center with a program featuring local ensembles and a presentation on neighborhood history. The event highlighted the contributions of community music schools and celebrated the cultural legacy of the West Medford community.

items.title: West Medford Community Center History
items.summary: Terry Carter provided a historical overview of the West Medford African American community and the origins of the neighborhood known as 'The Ville.'

items.title: Festival Introduction and Sponsor Recognition
items.summary: Producer Jonathan Fagan acknowledged the sponsors and staff supporting the festival's fifth season and introduced the night's focus on adult music students.

items.title: Morningside Jazz All-Stars Performance
items.summary: The Morningside Jazz All-Stars performed a set of standards and contemporary pieces featuring vocalist Debbie Lane and rotating rhythm sections.

items.title: AJ and the Groove Performance
items.summary: Anita Wood and her collective performed a series of jazz standards and an original composition titled 'I'm Glad You're Here.'

items.title: Closing Announcements and Weekend Preview
items.summary: Organizers previewed the upcoming weekend schedule and provided information on community music schools in the Medford area.
